title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 60+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.

Roles we commonly hire for in Brazil

  • Business Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • Data Scientist
  • Designer
  • Finance Analyst
  • FinCrime Analyst
  • Operations Manager
  • Product Manager
  • Recruiter
  • Software Engineer
  • Support Specialist

This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.

If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.

Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.

Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our .

Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.

What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.

What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently, clearly, and accurately to all levels
  • A confident, self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail

Nice to have

  • Fluency in another language
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: BIM Modeler - Civil
description:
Civil BIM Modeler - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

title: IT Risk & Audit Professional
description:
Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for a IT risk & audit professional at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo, Brazil, hybrid, fulltime

BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.

The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.

Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.

how you will contribute

As IT auditor you are part of the, Business Risk & Audit - IT focus team and are going to:

  • perform and assist internal audit projects and internal control evaluation related to 'digital' processes, such as general IT processes, IT program & project management, 3rd party assurance, security, business IT (automated) controls, RPA, AI and BCP.
  • together with other team members you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as IT and global IT program organizations
  • provide coaching & development for your team members with respect to IT general controls, application controls and other technical expertise's required within Risk & Audit.
  • support the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities in your domain to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.

what you will be doing

  • participate in risk assessments and assist in audit planning and scoping, such as: IT general controls, automated controls, RPA and IT projects.
  • perform IT controls/process audits on scope elements.
  • lead and execute audits, for technical domains, including: physical security, ethical hacking and technical validation of controls on multiple OSI layers.
  • support combined comfort analyses on maturity of IT general controls relevant domains (combining audit insights with other sources of data such as internal control projects, management controls self-assessment and developments within the company)
  • participate and lead audit interviews, accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a resource for colleagues with less expertise.

who will you work with

  • Partners/communities within the IT operations and projects space
  • IT security, data protection, information security and business continuity communities within the Randstad organization.
  • Business risk & audit partners
  • IT & digital leadership
  • External co-source partners
  • BR &A F stakeholders/clients within the business including local MT's, process and control owners

what you will bring

Your in depth understanding and experience with general IT management processes, business enabling through it (automated controls, RPA and IA) combined with risk & audit skills are well developed. As a critical challenger to management you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest in enabling an effective balance in managing IT effectively while enabling the business to operate optimally leveraging IT. You have a sharp eye for improvements strengthening management controls structurally in the context of what works best within the company setting and not taking it from a theoretical perspective.

You:

  • have minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant experience
  • have at minimum a bachelor degree in IT, business or economics.
  • are qualified as IT auditor (e.g. CISA, RE or equivalent).

You work and act in a way that:

  • creates clarity - showing line of sight (analytical skills): you collect and analyze data to solve problems, make decisions and advice within your professional boundaries.
  • collaborates, reaches out (organizational sensitivity): maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization
  • ensures the business, thus: align, improve, execute and promote systems and work processes that support the business in achieving its goals and complies with internal and external standards and regulatory requirements.
  • co-drives the business, thus: provide insights into drivers for value creation and act as business partner in making decisions that enhance performance.
  • applies outside- in thinking (curiosity), with: unrest to push the boundary, eagerness, examination of new possibilities by investigating and asking questions, exploring and/or discovering new possibilities and assuming something better is still out there. You are comfortable leading what isn’t understood.

As IT auditor you:

  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo

have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job coaching and development

Your competences demonstrates you can:

  • support the development of an audit universe and audit approaches on IT risks and opportunities, as well as assist in building cyber assurance practices within Randstad.
  • prepare audit plannings and scoping on identified (cyber) risks & opportunities.
  • lead and execute internal audits/review for operational business processes, with focus on cyber and give guidance and/or instructions to junior staff in audit projects.
  • report and communicate audit findings at the right tone to make impact and provide recommendations for improvements.

Your Business English is at level BEC B1/B2 or higher.

As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, it is relevant, as part of the job, you are willing to travel. Travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.

your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • strategic mindset: seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances

what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad .

title: Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Rio de Janeiro e Região)
description:
Vaga para Representante | PJ/ Parceria/ Canal de Vendas

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Sobre a nossa vaga de Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Rio de Janeiro e Região)

Estamos em busca de Representantes Comerciais apaixonados por inovação e excelência no atendimento ao cliente para se juntarem à nossa equipe na divisão de Odontologia.

Como representante da marca ZEISS, você será responsável por:

- Prospecção Ativa: Identificar e engajar novos clientes, expandindo nossa presença no mercado odontológico.

- Demonstração de Produtos: Apresentar as características e benefícios das nossas Lupas de Magnificação e Microscópios Cirúrgicos.

- Relacionamento com o Cliente: Realizar visitas de pós-venda para garantir a satisfação e fidelização, além de identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.

- Educação Continuada: Participar ativamente de cursos, congressos e eventos, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor.

- Gestão de Vendas: Utilizar o CRM para gerenciar o funil de vendas, apresentar previsões e fechar negócios de forma eficaz.

Requisitos:

- Experiência mínima de 8 anos em vendas no setor odontológico.

- Histórico comprovado de sucesso em vendas e superação de metas.

- Conhecimento profundo do mercado e produtos odontológicos.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal.

- Disponibilidade para viagens e participação em eventos.

- Desejável conhecimento em CRM SAP.

- Inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado será um diferencial.

Benefícios:

- Comissão competitiva por venda, oferecendo um potencial ilimitado de ganhos.

ATUAÇÃO COMO PARCEIRO/ REPRESENTANTE/ CANAL DE VENDAS (PJ)

Se você está pronto para fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da inovação em odontologia, aplique agora mesmo através do LinkedIn. A equipe da Carl Zeiss do Brasil está ansiosa para conhecer os próximos líderes de vendas que se juntarão a nós nessa jornada.

title: Gerente de Contas Estratégicas
description:
Gerente de Contas Estratégicas

Responsável por estabelecer e manter relacionamento C-Level em clientes estratégicos globais, os quais possuem os maiores volumes existentes e potenciais nas linhas de negócios (Digital Solutions, Data Management, Records Management, Asset Lifecycle Management e Insight). Sendo responsável por planejar e executar ações estratégicas em conjunto com o time de Global Industries.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e fortalecer relações com executivos C-Level em contas globais estratégicas de alto volume e potencial;
  • Planejar e executar ações em sinergia com o time global de Global Industries (Managing Director, GAM e GAR);
  • Realizar o planejamento anual da conta, incorporando tendências de mercado e alinhamento com estratégias globais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de negócio e conduzi-las do início ao fechamento, com foco em geração de receita (cross-selling e up-selling);
  • Atuar com postura consultiva, compreendendo profundamente as necessidades dos clientes e oferecendo soluções personalizadas;
  • Promover trocas com pares internacionais para replicação de boas práticas localmente;
  • Elaborar e negociar propostas comerciais com suporte de áreas internas, buscando condições favoráveis para todas as partes;
  • Garantir conformidade contratual, renovação e aplicação de reajustes previstos;
  • Realizar visitas periódicas aos clientes para mapear necessidades, oportunidades e manter alto nível de engajamento;
  • Construir estratégias de fidelização e satisfação contínua das contas sob sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida na gestão de grandes contas B2B e relacionamento executivo;
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório); Espanhol desejável.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência internacional ou interação com stakeholders globais;
  • Capacidade analítica e perfil colaborativo;
  • Visão de negócios e senso de urgência.

title: Warehouse Procurement Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle e-retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

Requirements

  • Sourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers and vendors to secure the best prices, quality, and delivery terms. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, ensuring reliability and alignment with our brand values.
  • Purchasing Strategy: Develop and implement procurement strategies that drive cost savings, quality improvements, and operational efficiency. Analyze market trends and supplier performance to make informed procurement decisions.
  • Inventory management: Collaborate with inventory management teams to ensure optimal stock levels and timely replenishment of products. Monitor inventory turnover rates and implement strategies to minimize excess stock and reduce carrying costs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, quality, engineering, and quality teams to ensure that procurement aligns with product development and promotional strategies. Participate in product development meetings to provide insights on material sourcing and cost implications.
  • Sustainability Initiatives: Champion sustainable sourcing practices and collaborate with suppliers to promote environmentally friendly materials and processes. Monitor compliance with ethical sourcing standards and regulations.
  • Budget Management: Prepare and manage the procurement budget, ensuring alignment with financial goals and targets. Track and report on savings and procurement performance metrics.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Fashion Merchandising, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in procurement within the fashion retail industry.

Preferred Skills

  • Being familiar with normal logistic packing material and service related to warehouse running.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience with contract management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful procurement strategies.
  • Knowledge of sustainable and ethical sourcing practices.
  • Proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Fluent English.

CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Senior Business Analyst I (L4)
description:
What is Teachable ?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About your Team

Growth Marketing at Teachable focuses on bringing more creators to our platform by optimizing each step of the growth funnel. We work closely with Product, Partnerships and Brand & Content, in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. We embrace testing new hypotheses, fail fast and quickly apply those learnings through a very data-driven approach. We're always adapting as both our company and industry continue to evolve, while keeping the ultimate goal of connecting with and supporting creators.

What is the role?

We are looking for a strategic and data-driven Business Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for translating complex marketing and business data into actionable insights that drive our growth strategy. You will leverage your structured problem-solving approach and analytical mindset to partner within the Growth, Brand, Partnerships, Product, Data and Finance teams to develop and implement measurement frameworks, analyze performance. You will identify strategic opportunities for optimization which you’re likely to lead or advise all the way through implementation.

This position reports to the Marketing Analytics Lead and plays a crucial role in fostering a data-driven decision-making culture throughout the organization.

This position is hybrid to our São Paulo office. Although flexible, local employees tend to use our São Paulo office 1-2 times a week.

Additionally, this position will collaborate with American employees on a daily basis, so fluency in English is required.

In this role you'll:

  • Build and maintain impactful marketing dashboards using Sigma, Google Analytics, Heap, and Looker that drive business decisions
  • Analyze marketing campaigns across channels to optimize performance and allocation of resources
  • Define and track key metrics (LTV, CAC, Churn, Retention, Conversion Rates) to evaluate business health
  • Design and analyze A/B tests to optimize conversion funnels and marketing effectiveness
  • Own weekly reporting processes to deliver insights to stakeholders, including executive leadership
  • Help develop and improve attribution models to better understand marketing ROI and customer journeys
  • Apply structured problem-solving to complex challenges and develop data-driven solutions
  • Identify growth opportunities through trend analysis and funnel optimization
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure quality data collection and integration
  • Translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations with implementation roadmaps

What you'll bring:

  • 2-3 years in business analysis in strategic consulting roles or 3 + years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Previous Marketing Analytics experience is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of key business metrics: LTV, CAC, Churn, Retention, and Conversion Funnel metrics
  • Knowledge of digital marketing metrics, attribution models, and customer acquisition economics
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and experiments with statistical rigor
  • Ability to structure complex problems and drive data-driven decision making
  • Excellent communication skills to translate data findings for diverse audiences
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for data modeling and analysis
  • SQL proficiency and experience with BI tools like Sigma and Power BI
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Heap, or similar web analytics platforms
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Economics, or related fields

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling
  • Understanding (and willing to learn!) on how to leverage AI implementation in analytics and operations workflows
  • Interest in the creator economy landscape and digital education platforms
  • Experience with marketing automation platforms like Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Background in SaaS or subscription-based business models

Additional details:

At Teachable, we are committed to providing fair and competitive pay (using market data to inform our pay bands), rewarding high performance, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and ability to impact Teachable’s overall company value. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically following performance review cycles currently conducted bi-annually or in conjunction with a promotion.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations! Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

  • Executar medição em juntas tubulares;
  • Realizar testes e ensaios não destrutivos em soldas e acompanhar testes hidrostáticos.

Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Técnica ou Superior nas áreas da Qualidade, Mecânica, Metalurgia, Produção, Civil ou demais áreas afins;
  • Experiência profissional pregressa no cargo, com atuação na área industrial e / ou da construção civil pesada;
  • Certificação Norma ABNT NBR 15523 (Inspetor/a de Controle Dimensional);
  • Certificação SNQC/ABENDI (Ensaios Não Destrutivos);
  • Alta capacidade analítica e de percepção visual;
  • Sólido domínio do manuseio de instrumentos e ferramentas de alta precisão;
  • Disponibilidade e mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região de Sorocaba/SP.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:

✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações

Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

title: Country Manager
description:

ꔷ Market Leadership & Strategy

Own and drive Alibaba.com’s growth strategy in Brazil across supplier acquisition, activation, and export readiness. Analyze local market trends, competitor dynamics, and policy changes to inform business decisions.

ꔷ Team & Organizational Leadership

Build and lead high-performing local teams across business development, marketing, customer success, and operations. Establish a strong performance culture and ensure alignment with Alibaba’s global goals and values.

ꔷ Business Development & Partnerships

Identify and develop key industry verticals and top-tier Brazilian exporters (SMEs and large manufacturers). Forge partnerships with industry associations, export agencies, and logistics/fintech partners to build a strong ecosystem.

ꔷ P&L & Performance Management

Own Brazil’s P&L responsibility, including growth targets, sales metrics, user acquisition, and retention KPIs. Implement data-driven management practices to track performance and optimize ROI.

ꔷ Cross-functional Collaboration

Act as the bridge between Brazil and HQ teams in China and other regions, ensuring seamless communication and alignment. Provide market insights and feedback to help shape product localization and platform optimization.

Qualifications:

ꔷ 7+ years of progressive experience in e-commerce industry, or digital B2B trade.

ꔷ Proven track record in leading teams and driving business growth in Brazil.

ꔷ Strong understanding of the Brazilian export ecosystem, cross-border trade, and digital transformation.

ꔷ Entrepreneurial mindset, strategic thinker, and execution-oriented.

ꔷ Fluent in English and Mandarin (Portuguese is a plus).

ꔷ Bachelor's degree required; Master’s in Business, International Trade, or related field is preferred.

title: Senior Server Administrator (Tableau)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Tableau Server Administrator to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the retail/food services/technology area.

Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .

Only resumes in English will be reviewed. All interviews will be in English only (must be fluent)

Responsibilities :

  • Ability to setup and configure Tableau servers on various on prem and cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with server upgrades and parameter changes
  • Proficiency in connecting Tableau to different data sources and extract data from these sources
  • Manage user permissions, security, and access within Tableau environments
  • Troubleshoot Tableau performance issues and optimizing dashboards

Requirements:

  • Minimum 10 years of IT experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Tableau Servers
  • Strong understanding of Tableau architecture, including workbooks, data sources, extract refresh schedules, and server maintenance.
  • Knowledge of Tableau Server features, including scheduling, content management, and server configuration.
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL) to troubleshoot data-related issues.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or batch scripting for automating administrative tasks is a plus.
  • Understanding of data governance concepts and experience implementing data security measures in Tableau.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS) is a plus but not required
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to explain and understand problems effectively
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills
  • Time zone: Pacific Time Zone preferred, but flexibility is possible

  • Desejável experiência anterior no setor de ortopedia ou saúde, bem como conhecimento em sistemas de vendas.

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis parceiro da Apolar Jardim Botânico é um profissional dinâmico e proativo, responsável pela comercialização de imóveis prontos (usados) e lançamentos em Curitiba e Região Metropolitana.

Como ter sucesso no cargo: O sucesso nesta função é impulsionado pela capacidade de entender e antecipar as necessidades dos clientes, oferecendo soluções imobiliárias que geram valor. Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. Profissionais que se destacam são aqueles que cultivam relações de confiança, dominam as técnicas de negociação, e mantêm-se atualizados sobre o mercado imobiliário e as condições de financiamento. A colaboração com a equipe e o alinhamento com os objetivos da franquia são diferenciais para alcançar o sucesso.

Responsabilidades
  • Angariar Imóveis: Identificar e angariar ativamente imóveis (usados e lançamentos) na região de Curitiba e Região Metropolitana, expandindo o portfólio da franquia e visando atingir a meta de 100 imóveis em carteira.
  • Gestão de Leads: Gerenciar e qualificar leads provenientes de diversas fontes (portais de anúncio, anúncios patrocinados, portal da Rede Apolar, LAIS), realizando o primeiro contato, acompanhamento e nutrição para convertê-los em clientes qualificados.
  • Uso de CRM: Determinar e desenvolver requisitos de usuários para sistemas em produção (Apolar Sales), garantindo o preenchimento completo e organizado de todas as informações de clientes, imóveis e interações, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado, compreendendo a real necessidade do cliente, apresentando as opções de imóveis mais adequadas e conduzindo visitas de forma eficaz.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Conduzir processos de negociação de compra e venda, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de contratos, garantindo a segurança e transparência em todas as etapas da transação.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe: Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de corretores, gerência e franqueados parceiros, compartilhando informações de mercado, estratégias e melhores práticas para otimização dos resultados coletivos.
  • Avaliação de Imóveis: Colaborar no processo de avaliação de imóveis quando solicitado, utilizando o conhecimento de mercado e, se certificado, o registro no CNAI.
  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado/a sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário de Curitiba, novas legislações, condições de financiamento e o perfil de cada bairro para oferecer um serviço consultivo de excelência.
Qualificações
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo. Curso superior, é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • Registro Profissional: Possuir registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (CRECI).
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia comprovada na comercialização de imóveis, com preferência para atuação em imóveis usados e/ou lançamentos.
  • Competências de Comunicação: Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e habilidade para se comunicar por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Habilidade Tecnológica: Familiaridade e disposição para utilizar ferramentas de CRM (Apolar Sales) e outras tecnologias para gestão de leads, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações.
  • Proatividade e Resiliência: Capacidade de agir com proatividade na busca por resultados e na angariação de imóveis, além de resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do mercado.
  • Orientação para o Cliente: Forte orientação para o cliente, com foco em entender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos de confiança e proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva.
  • Organização: Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes para manter registros precisos e acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Infraestrutura: Possuir carro, notebook, acesso à internet fora do escritório e celular para desempenho das atividades.

title: LÍDER CENTRO DE OPERAÇÕES AGROINDUSTRIAIS (COA)
description:

- Monitorar e validar dados operacionais enviados para outros setores, assegurando precisão e confiabilidade das informações;

- Ser ponto de apoio no contato entre analistas do COA e áreas estratégicas como: manutenção, qualidade, CTT e planejamento;

- Participar de reuniões com clientes internos para discutir estratégias, melhorias e resultados operacionais;

- Identificar gargalos e propor soluções inovadoras para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos operacionais.

Ensino Superior Completo em Logística, Engenharias, Administração ou correlatas;

Vivência na liderança de pessoas;

Pacote office avançado;

Domínio em Sistemas logísticos e ERPs agrícolas (LogTrac, SGPA, Simple Farm, Gatec, SAP, PIMS;

Disponibilidade para turnos;

Residir em Olímpia, Severínia, Cajobi ou Baguaçu/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

Realizar estudos analíticos que busquem oportunidades de negócios. Os principais desafios do cargo consistem na construção e tratamento de dados para estudos e modelagem. Desenvolvimento modelos preditivos com a máxima performance usando técnicas estatísticas e de machine learning. Elaboração de novas variáveis que desafiem as variáveis padrão de definição de risco. Avaliação e testes de informações de fornecedores externos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Realizar análises de dados utilizando técnicas estatísticas para a tomada de decisão.
  • Estruturar e construir bases de dados para estudos e modelagem.
  • Desenvolver, implantar documentar e acompanhar modelos preditivos para crédito.
  • Utilizar softwares de manipulação de dados e análises estatísticas.
  • Realizar backtest de modelos com parceiros.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos, dashboards e apresentações para Fóruns e Comitês.
  • Disseminar conhecimento e apoiar tecnicamente o time.
  • Trazer propostas de melhoria e inovação para a área.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimentos básicos de estatística
  • Conhecimentos de modelagem de crédito
  • Conhecer técnicas de Machine Learning
  • Pacote Office
  • R/Python/SAS/SQL ou similares

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimentos em modelagem de crédito
  • Conhecimentos de Inteligência Artificial
  • Ferramentas de visualização de dados como Looker/Power BI
  • Conhecimentos de engenharia de dados
  • Conhecimentos de Big Query

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Allya: app que oferece descontos em quase 30 mil estabelecimentos por todo Brasil, ex: farmácia, restaurante, salão, academia, etc;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo

Quem Somos:​

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!​

Nosso Jeito:​

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.​

Valores e Propósito:​

Nosso propósito é re solver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos​.

Diversidade e inclusão:​

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.​

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.
